verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce catalog layer that aggregates merchant products for agents, so merchant-side controls over agent access are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only developer and agent-facing features: search, MCP, SDK, CLI, pricing/MPP, and price-tracking webhooks. Nothing shows a merchant can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents or agent platforms on its catalog or checkout.
